messages:
Marisa: Heads-up — ran a scheduled KMS throttling playback against staging at 08:15 and hit a behavior we should discuss.
Alex L.: what did the playback simulate? burst rps + throttles?
Marisa: yes — 6x normal RPS for 60s, then sudden drop. We expected graceful degrations but saw a brief spike of 502s from the envelope service.
Ivan G.: logs?
Marisa: pasted minimal snippet:
```
2026-02-12T08:15:21Z envelope-decrypt WARN retry=1 error=KMS::Throttling
2026-02-12T08:15:21Z envelope-decrypt WARN fallback=cache hit=false
2026-02-12T08:15:22Z envelope-decrypt ERROR api=svc.payouts status=502 proxied_error=upstream_timeout
```
Samir R.: sounds like the client retried immediately and exhausted connection pool -> upstream timeout.
Marisa: exactly. playback used current client defaults (no jitter, linear retry with 3 attempts). We had a transient window where many requests
reached the fallback path simultaneously and overloaded the envelopes service threadpool.
Alex L.: did the fallback to cached DEKs work at all?
Marisa: only ~40% hits. Cache TTL configured 30s; with the burst pattern cache warmed unevenly because many keys were cold.
Ivan G.: two things: add exponential backoff + randomized jitter, and make the DEK cache population opportunistic (pre-warm on rotate?).
Samir R.: agree. also add a small circuit-breaker on the envelope service to fail fast and surface clear metrics to SLO dashboard.
Marisa: good. Also discovered audit log gaps — when KMS client returned throttling we didn't emit structured audit events for the envelope flow (only for successful encrypt/decrypt). Need audit for all code paths.
Alex L.: +1. compliance will want a timeline if this hits prod. we should also record whether RBAC retry roles are hitting limits (iam principals per-minute).
Ivan G.: noted: add metrics: kms.requests, kms.throttled, dek.cache.hit/miss, envelope.queue.depth, envelope.circuit.state. Emit tags: region/model/key-id.
Marisa: short-term mitigation: push a client patch (exp backoff + jitter), bump cache TTL to 2m behind a feature flag, and enable circuit-breaker default to 50 rps per instance.
Samir R.: can we test the patch in canary with the same playback? kms-sim-bot can replay with variable key distributions.
kms-sim-bot: scheduled replay -> staging on 2026-02-12T09:30. profile: burst=8x, duration=90s, key_spread=high.
oncall-bot: added incident channel #incidents-kms-test and will post alerts if envelope error rate > 1% for 5m.
Alex L.: follow-ups (assign): Ivan = metrics + dashboards, Samir = client patch + rollout plan, Marisa = audit events + runbook updates. I'll own the canary run and post results.
Marisa: thanks. created PR drafts for audit changes and runbook notes: https://git.redwood/infrasec/kms-playbooks/pull/42
Ivan G.: will have dashboards + alerts by EOD. Samir — ping when PR ready and I'll wire alerts to it.
Samir R.: PR opened for client changes, tests added. will coordinate canary after Ivan confirms dashboards.
Marisa: closing loop — we didn't hit production but this was a useful near-miss. action items in the runbook look solid. :thumbsup:
Alex L.: nice find, great team response. keep me posted if anything changes.
